title: Keep a named number
summary: Ruby: Keep a named number. Change the starting count to 6.
introduction: Ruby variables give names to values. The plus sign adds numbers.
learningObjectives: Keep a named number with Ruby

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.
pencils holds 3. The expression adds 2 and passes 5 to puts.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not put number values in quotes when you want maths.
